reason: Prevent a transient open-PR snapshot fence change from becoming a persistent trusted-collision blocker while preserving the first fail-closed evaluation and all substantive HOLD conditions.

changes.reason: Boundedly recompute trusted collision preflight only when the sole reason code is snapshot_changed_during_evaluation, there are no collisions or inspection errors, and main/candidate SHAs remained stable. Preserve per-attempt reports and fail after three attempts or immediately on any substantive condition.

exclusions: No collision severity threshold is weakened.
No failed evaluation is converted to PASS.
Any real collision, inspection error, provider read failure, changed main SHA, changed candidate SHA, or additional HOLD reason remains immediately fail-closed.
Retry count is bounded to three evaluations; exhaustion remains failure.
No D3, credential, provider-write, payout, release, or money-movement authority is added.
